name: @oapogee/hardware
description: tscircuit source for the oApogee payload. Deliberately outside the yarn workspace: installing tscircuit at the repository root rehoists node_modules and moves next out of where eslint expects it, breaking lint and build for everyone who has never opened a schematic. This directory keeps its own node_modules and is installed on demand by `make hw-deps`.

scripts.postinstall: echo '  tscircuit installed. Run `make hw` from the repository root.'
